recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Add createPolicyService() to the policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: The policy module must own its own composition before balance/leave can delegate. Add the factory to policy.service.ts and export it from policy/index.ts. No behavior change; policy already depends on leave-type.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Rewire createBalanceService() to call createPolicyService()
recommended_phases.rationale: Remove the balance -> leave-type import by delegating PolicyService construction to the policy factory. Drops the LeaveTypeService/PgLeaveTypeRepository import from balance.service.ts.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Rewire createLeaveService() to call createPolicyService()
recommended_phases.rationale: Remove the identical leave -> leave-type import by delegating PolicyService construction to the policy factory. Drops the LeaveTypeService/PgLeaveTypeRepository import from leave.service.ts.

app_notes: Composition-only refactor. Add createPolicyService() to src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts (constructs `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))`) and re-export it from src/modules/policy/index.ts. Then change createBalanceService() (balance.service.ts) and createLeaveService() (leave.service.ts) to call createPolicyService() instead of constructing PolicyService themselves, removing their `../leave-type` imports. No service constructor signatures, public interfaces, or runtime behavior change. After the change, no file under src/modules/balance or src/modules/leave imports from '../leave-type', satisfying the ARCHITECTURE.md dependency map (balance allowed deps: employee, policy, shared-date, shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db; leave -> policy, not leave-type). The policy module already legitimately depends on leave-type (PolicyService injects ILeaveTypeService), so the factory lives there and no new cross-module import is introduced. No new service methods are added — createPolicyService is a factory, not a service interface method.
auth_contract: No new API surface or role-gated access is introduced by this composition refactor; existing endpoints and their auth contract are unchanged.
error_response_contract: No new endpoints are introduced; existing error/response contract is unchanged.
